subject: maths
question:
Simplify the given expression.

b + 2a - [(3b + a) - (2a + b) + 2a] - a
solution:
**Given:**

b + 2a - [(3b + a) - (2a + b) + 2a] - a

**Calculation:**

⇒ b + 2a - [3b + a - 2a - b + 2a] - a

⇒ b + 2a - [2b - a + 2a] - a

⇒ b + 2a - [2b + a] - a

⇒ b + 2a - 2b - a - a

⇒ b - 2b + 2a - a - a

⇒ -b + 0a

⇒ -b

**Therefore, the simplified expression is -b.**
